bio: Just 50 seconds in the lift and you are up on the 23rd floor, from which the view is simply magnificent. Modern cuisine is served in an urban-style interior: enquire about the extensive selection of meats; vegetarians are also catered for. In addition, there's a good bar serving a snack menu from 5pm. In summer, weather permitting, head to the 24th-floor Heaven's Nest for drinks and light bites....
